place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The view at this spot is absolutely magnificent. The backdrop steals the show and sets a beautifully relaxing mood. It is the kind of picturesque setting where you instantly want to pull out your phone and start taking photos. What truly elevates the entire experience, however, is the staff. Every single team member we encountered was incredibly kind, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. They greeted us with warm smiles, checked in on us at the perfect moments, and went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable. Even though the meal was ordinary, the combination of the stunning view and the beautiful hospitality made it a highly enjoyable visit.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The service was amazing, the crew were really nice and attentive. Unfortunately, the food was not good. The nachos were okay, i guess. The fries were just fries (who could mess up fries? lol) and the burgers were really MID, it really didnt have any flavor aside from the sauce and the added ketchup. The view was nice as well, it was very windy as well so it wasn't hot that night. I hope they really improve the taste of the food because the concept of a sky cafe is cool and all but the food just fell flat. This is no diss to the people working inside the kitchen and are all my personal takeaways. ^^

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I went there after our Pastor at COP Davao recommended to go there after church back when I visited Davao. The choco drink is too sweet for me, but the rest are good. Portion size is really big, so I had to pack the chicken wings for takeout instead. There’s a rooftop deck to get a view of Samal Island!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I’d heard some people say this place was rather overpriced for their food, but honestly, I found the value to be excellent. The food was delicious and far exceeded my expectations for the price point. Plus, with the fast service and accommodating staff, you really get your money's worth. The only downside for me is that the I can’t find any electrical plugs available on the upper deck when I wanted to charge my gadget, although they have few ones on the lower deck tables facing their counter but it doesn’t have the view. But still, a very chill and great experience!"

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe is one of those places in Davao that feels like it has its own personality. Every time I go there, it gives me this casual, late-night, comfort-food kind of vibe that makes it easy to just relax and enjoy the moment. It is also 24/7. The food serving focuses on big portions and satisfying meals that actually hit the spot when you are hungry. There were times I went there expecting just a quick bite, but ended up surprisingly full and satisfied. The atmosphere is also a big part of the experience. It has that laid-back café feel where you can either hang out with friends or just sit quietly while eating. On good days, it even feels a bit cozy, especially when it’s not too crowded. It’s the kind of place where time passes without you really noticing. Service-wise, sometimes they took a long time to give your order.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Great place to eat and relax! They have high-quality burger options that taste fresh and satisfying. The ambience is comfortable and welcoming, with a nice city view that makes the experience even better. The employees are also very friendly and attentive. Definitely a great spot to visit for good food and a pleasant atmosphere.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It was a journey, but I think worth it. The staff was friendly, professional, and crazy 😁 The food was okay and the portions were healthy. We had their breakfast platters, P299. We enjoyed the drinks. We left full. 🤗 I'll bet you'll enjoy the view at night. The downsides are parking and the stairs. We had a two block walk. The elevator is out of order. It's a bit of a climb to the top floor. When we go back, we'll try the burgers. They looked 👍 good 😊

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Such a surprise hiding on the rooftop of a non-description building! Evening dining was refreshing and breezy with a great view of the city lights. You can choose to eat at the very top level with open sides with safe railings or below. Order at the counter and get a buzzer to come take your food with a tray. But the staff brought our meals to us maybe since we were a group with small children. You’re met with a cheery shouted greeting and they call out a farewell also. All staff were noticeably friendly. We noticed that the catchy music playing was personalized (AI?) with the Crazy Bite name 😆. Burgers are good; different than an American burger but really tasty with soft buns. The platters are very filling even when shared. Highly recommend for a special outing or maybe to watch the sun rise!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Our dining was not bad. They offer fast food options such as burgers,fries, and rice meals. They also have several drinks such as juices and coffee. The catch in this restaurant is it is located on the rooftop wherein you can see Davao's view. The price is moderately expensive. The comfort room is not dirty.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: As you enter the establishment, the staff will welcome you with warm and lively greetings. Best time to go early in the morning and catch the sunrise because the view at the rooftop is immaculate. The food are CHEAP but QUALITY! I guess I can say the price range is affordable. It's really good and there's lots of options to choose from. The staff were also very accommodating and approachable during our time there; volunteering to even help us take our own photos. We went on a not so good day though, which was the morning before New Year 2024. Unfortunately, some options on the menu weren't available. (Context: They were about to close that early morning when we came). So yes, best to just not go during this busy time. Just a piece of advice I can give based on what I've observed so far. Nonetheless, it was a great experience for first timers like us (me and my mom). I'll be back again next year, maybe?

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The staff at Crazy Bite Co are enthusiastic and attentive, greeting you warmly upon entry. However, the food is nothing special and not worth its price.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Bad view, basically nothing. Food is.... Nothing special. Staff is very attentive but 500 pesos for 1 basic burger, fries, and 3 wings is wild in thee Philippines. There's so many place I will go before I go here again. Krispy Kreme burger was gross, I've had them many times in America but for some reason the donuts here were COLD and HARD.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I can't deny that the Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe has been my safe place for a year and five months, and I hope we'll be together for many more years. This cafe is a 100/10, and it could be your escape and go-to place whenever you don't want to go home. On top of that, I love their food! *chef kiss! 😚* . Surely everyone knows that their food is one of the reasons why people keep coming back. Also, the people who run this cafe are very passionate. This establishment should be kept secret yet Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe deserves to be proud of and recommended to everyone. Long live the Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe! You will always be in my heart! 🫀

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We been here during dinner time and the place is crowded since food is great and now we are trying it for breakfast since we are in the city. All I can say that the reviews speaks loud for itself. Just be careful ⚠️in bringing your food to the top floor when its windy you might FALL in the wrong person eme... 😁 Hope you enjoy your days with the friends and the people you love...

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I went for an early morning walk, and to my pleasant surprise, I stumbled upon this hidden gem. Nestled on the top floor of a building, the restaurant boasts breathtaking views that add to the overall charm of the place. I decided to start my day with breakfast there, and I must say, the food exceeded my expectations. It was just right, with a delectable blend of flavors that satisfied my taste buds. Additionally, their coffee was a delightful treat that perfectly complemented my meal. What impressed me even more was the restaurant's thoughtful accommodation for those seeking privacy for work or meetings. They have a separate room that provides a suitable environment for professional endeavors. This attention to detail truly sets this restaurant apart from others and caters to a diverse range of needs. Whether you're seeking a scenic spot for a leisurely meal or a productive space for work, this place has it all.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food is very flavorful, you would prefer it if you have a taste for super savory meals. We went there at lunch so it felt really hot and humid. So, i think the place is better at night where you can enjoy a Davao skyline view.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: food is alright. mid range prices. somehow they didn’t have service water at the time we went. be prepared to exercise urself going upstairs if the elevator is full.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Updating review: wrong order was served. Paid 700+ for two meals but it was not worth it. Just go to jollibee, you’ll get better and tastier food. For now, you’re just paying for the place and the 24-hour availability. Entrance is at the right side of Maybank, you can enter through the door and there’s an elevator to get you to the 5th floor. Servers will greet you upon entering. Food was yummy but I found it too pricey, plus it took a while for it to be ready. It can be very windy at the top or hot, it really depends on the weather.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: What stood out during my visit was how energetic and enthusiastic their staff was. You could tell they were having fun greeting their guests in unison. I stayed on the upper deck and all the guests on there would give out a chuckle when a new customer arrives below. As for the food, it was reasonably priced. Serving was hefty and plating, instagrammable. I, on the other hand, wasn’t a fan of their coffee—it tasted watered down and too sweet ( I got a spanish latte). The 360 degree uninterrupted view of downtown Davao was amazing, too. Best place if you want to witness the sunrise. I wish they put up a sign where the exact entrance to the building is because I had some trouble looking for it (im not from Davao).

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: They weren’t kidding when they named it Sky Cafe. You can dine with a decent view of Davao City. The western food they served were above average compared to what you get from other restos in the city. Would dine again on a Friday night out with friends.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We went here for a dinner. It was literally on the rooftop of the building. The staff are very accommodating and courteous even though some are self service.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food: I love how creative the food was and it's eye pleasing however need to adjust about food pairing and if the flavor or the Variety is not available need to post "not available" on the menu however the taste is just fair. Service: The Crew are build with Awesomeness and Enthusiasm had a great experience how they offer to be the photographer in every picture taken, Just add precautions how they greet the customers so other may not be startle next time. Atmosphere: Architecture and designs are great it helps the ambiance more appealing makes the consumers to want more. "It was a great expereince for me how everything works at this place and I'm sure that I will definitely comeback hungry for more"

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: My first time coming here was shocking as I didn't expect to be greeted with very welcoming staff. It has pretty much typical choices for beverages and foods for a coffee shop. Very welcoming crew and clean tables, just don't have any helmet rack to place helmets onto. Parking spaces are limited in the day time. The atmosphere is great on the top deck. And I won't know if their fan is even turned on since the wind is blowing and running the fan in circles.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I guess they deserve to have a 5 star rating. I dont see any reason to rate lower for now. Ambiance is a big check ! Food prices js a super check ! Location is a check ! Service is a check , well its a self service where you will be the one to pick up your orders from the counter, though the staffs are energetic and nice ! Taste is a check also , makes me excited to try their other foods and drinks ! Its really windy and cool upside but you can choose to position on the lower part if you dont like high views or windy places.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Only delivery burger with quality 100% beef not any fillers or pork like alot of places use. Best delivery burger in Davao easily. Fries are mid but can't complain I order here often.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I came here with my sister to have dinner, and I can definitely agree that this sky café serves delicious food 10/10. And to add to that, the atmosphere in this café is very beautiful, especially if you go there early in the morning. The strong winds and the view there are definitely worth experiencing. So if you're looking for a worthwhile place to eat with a great view, I can highly recommend The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Café. I hope I can come back here again to taste their food and see the beautiful view once more!✨

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: upon entering, youd be greeted by the most enthusiastic service crew ever that it was almost a bit overwhelming. we went there but the rooftop was already full. they did take our name for a table reservation but we alrdy finished eating and all but our name still wasnt called, so we weren't able to experience the view from the top. anyway, we still dined at their floor below (they occupy 2 floors). the price was okay bc their servings are huge! was a bit sad bc the fries are served cold. the others were good. if u rlly want to get full, opt for their supermeal w like 4 different viands, 2 (or 3?) rice and 2 eggs.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: After the first simbang gabi for 2024, I needed to get breakfast. Beshy Google was as usual helpful and gave me several recomm. Crazy Bite was listed as the second, which was weird as it was the nearest. Took a Grab ride since it was my first time. Didn't know where it actually was. The driver also didnt't know where it was. We asked an on-duty S.G. in the area where LHL Bldg was, and voila. You have to take an elevator ride to go up to the 5th floor of LHL Bldg. When you get off, you take 2 more flights of stairs to get to the 6th floor where they were located. I was in for a surprise with the staff's energetic and ''crazy' greetings. They do the same thing when you leave. I ordered chicken and a burger. Went to the 2nd level (there are 2 levels) where I waited to be buzzed for my order. I liked the 2nd level better than the 1st. You get some sights there. 👀 Nothing on the 1st level, but it was better there during that 1st visit. Here's the reason why. Two customers (friends) sat at the table beside me. They were loud with expletives to match. The other customers at the other tables (there were 3 other occupied tables) were not the loud, dirty-mouth types. These 2 were. So. I moved down to the 1st level. (I should've taken a photo of those two as a warning to you. LOL). The food? Nothing crazy about the chicken, but at least it was not bland and fried perfectly. It was the cheese burger I was crazy about. The flavor was really good and it was still pleasantly warm, given it was the second to be consumed. The staff? Let's get back to that energetic greeting. The same energy is evident in the way most of them talk to each other. Loud. 🥴 Like the person they were talking to was a mile away, but were not. Same energy in the way they serve you and speak with you: fast, clearly and with a smile. The photo of the tissue holder and the message board right on top of it tells its own story. My first visit was not totally a bad one, not totally a good one either. It's a tie? 🤪

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Was there for brunch today around 11.30, and I will tell you straight away. When the sun is up, this place is super warm as it's on rooftop. Try to come earlier in the morning or later in a day when there's no sun out. Service was quick,polite, and guys are all very friendly and welcoming. If it's your first time coming in, don't get scared when they all start screaming "Welcome to Crazy Bite" as I did not expect this, so it was a funny experience. Food I had chicken fillets, with rice and fried egg. It was alright, nothing wow. Mostly, what is wow is view and location of the place. To go up, you need to enter the door on the right from the bank on the bottom floor. Go in the elevator and go on the 5th floor and then walk up to get to the 6th floor and be ready for them screaming their welcoming greeting. All in all, nice experience and nice views. But definitely come after 4pm when sun I lower down and you will enjoy much more.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Upon arrival, staff gracefully greet us. There were plenty of options but we were crabing chicken wings for dinner, and my sister also ordered beef tapa meal. Their chicken wings were juicy, perfectly cooked and seasoned, and we chose gravy, buffalo, and teriyaki as our sauces, they also has free condiments to choose from: ketchup, hot sauce, toyomansi. We ate at the rooftop area to enjoy the Davao City ambience. We will surely dine here again to try their burgers.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I’ve never had such soft beef tapas in my mouth! It’s not the traditional Filipino tapas but its a good kind of change. I thoroughly enjoyed my breakfast. The coffee’s also good. The view here is lovely. It’s a great place to escape from mundane routines of life. I hope to come back and try out the burgers next 😋

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Crazy Bite and Co is a restaurant that offers good food, a stunning city view, and a cozy atmosphere to hang out with friends and have late-night talks. The food is delicious and diverse, with something for everyone. The city view is amazing, especially at sunrise. The outdoor deck is spacious and comfortable, and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the restaurant is open late on weekends. Overall, Crazy Bite and Co is a great place to have a good meal, enjoy a beautiful view, and relax with friends.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The crazy bite co. has a good view of the davao skyline. It has a new good dining experience. The food is average and good for the price, it is very affordable but the place is too crowded as of now or the tables and chairs is limited in the good spot ( the upper deck ). The waiting time of food is quiet longer maybe because there's a lot of customers.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It's a good place to chill when it's not hot out. I would suggest going here when it is night time or at dawn. They have reasonable prices and the food is good. Coffee is good as well they are open 24 hours. Parking is a bit of a hassle when it is working hours. Fries and burger patties are great. Nachos lack mexican taste. They don't have service water.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Amazing food fair for its price. Joyful Friendly staffs and accommodating, been there twice and only tried the food and snacks, least to try their coffee but a lil bit risky to order espresso that is not well introduced. 9/10 👌

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We arrived at 1am.. place is cozy.. food has nice presentation..burger is good.. though not pure beef but its good.. you can really see davao in 360 view which is good.. we should've come here at sunset or sunrise ..its cold already without AC specially during dawn..nice place!!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Went there yesterday because of high reviews overall. Should have read the bad ones first! Food is terrible and low quality. Corned beef I'd cheapest local canned. Egg was overcooked. German sausage was terrible. Beef tapa was terrible.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The place will be packed in peak hours and you have to wait for 30min. to an hour as this situated in the 5th floor. Once you get in, you'll be amazed with the relaxing view (I suggest going here before sunset). Service is good and food is great. No hassle as they accept all types of payment method. Will be back for more as there are food items on the menu that I haven't tried due to its limited availability but so far, 👌🤌

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe one afternoon with a friend, and I wanted to share my experience with you. The atmosphere was wonderful, the food was delicious, and the service was impeccable. It was truly a memorable time.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Customer service is top tier. The food is okay and the place is very cozy.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: If you're out of places to go to past midnight, this is a really amazing spot to hang out. The place has two levels and only the top one has the overlooking view. Fortunately their staff are very quick in making sure that those who wanna sit at the top will get a spot as soon as a table gets vacant. Honestly, the food isn't the highlight of this place. Everything is cooked well but nothing stands out flavor-wise. They also do not provide service water and thus you would need to buy bottled water.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food are delicious. They are open 24/7. Most of the foods they have are burgers. They also have rice meals. I also love their breakfast meals. Very accommodating staff and good place since the restaurant is located at the rooftop, it has a nice view of the city

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Any kind of service crew asking you to move tables in a middle of a meal should be re trained. This place has shitty food and only has service and atmosphere to offer, then they immediately mess up the service. Please retrain your crew.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food is affordable, exactly priced. The serving of food takes too long, about 30 minutes. We had to wait on a long queue before we could get a seat. What's the rave about this cafe? Probably the roof deck where you'll see Davao's skyline.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: OPEN 24 HOURS! The staff is super energetic and welcoming. Even if you decide to eat here at 1 AM, it is bright and lively. Food choices in the menu were interesting, and looked appetizing (In-photo: Chicken Teriyaki Meal, Beef Tapa Meal, and KK Burger). I was really impressed with their donut burger, it was something new to me and it tastes really great. Great casual place to hangout at late at night or early morning!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: First time here and was welcomed with a nice good afternoon. The waitress at the register was very rude and food way overpriced ,quality poor. The view is obstructed by fencing all around the dining area. For the money so many other nice restraunts in Davao City will be the first and last time for us....It actually reminds me of McDonald's but with double the price.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: We had an amazing breakfast here. Staffs were friendly and it feels very unique to dine here since the cafe is located on a rooftop 🤘🤘

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: I absolutely adored how welcoming and accommodating their store was – entering and leaving was a breeze! The food was fantastic and absolutely worth the price; we weren't disappointed at all! Although it was a little hot inside at the time.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Crazy how amazing their view and service is considering we as a group were 20+ and had our orders served on time (6am at that). Recommended for group gatherings and eat outs! 🔥🔥🔥

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It was a rainy day when I visited so the view wasn’t really spectacular. But I guess with better weather the view would also be great. The cafe is located on the 6th floor. The food is okay. I ordered big breakfast A. The serving was fair with the price, not overwhelming. The corned beef was too salty for me. I liked the sweetness of the beef tapa.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Good food, strategic location, and nice ambiance. However, it is not accessible for people with disabilities because the elevators are only available from the 2nd to 5th floor. You have to take the stairs up to the 2nd floor, then take the elevator up to the 5th floor, and finally take the stairs up to the 6th floor/roof deck where the sky cafe is located.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: In my opinion, everything is a 5 star. Food: Delicious and well seasoned food. There are a lot of food choices that you can choose from. Prices are reasonable and expect value for money. Service: It was definitely my first time from a restaurant or cafeteria that they greeted us enthusiastically. "CRAAZYY MORNING, WELCOME TO CRAZY BITE, ENJOY YOUR MEAL!" and they do this in unison and to most of the customers. The enthusiasm and upbeat is contagious. Atmosphere: I like the vibe, color combination, and their displays of ornaments. I was able to read their history board, they had really humbling beginnings, kudos to the proprietor(s). It is located on top of the building, 5th floor so you can expect a high view. Our group visited during breakfast but were still amazed by the breeze at the top. Hopefully I will be able to visit there again in Davao and definitely go to this place for dinner and enjoy the city lights. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The place was great and the staff were very nice and welcoming, the view from the top was amazing! You can see a large part of the city there. The lobby like part of the establishment has a backyard party vibe in it, which was a nice touch. Beside the horrendous use of stairs in my first visit (the elevator is probably fixed now), the food was delicious! Albeit expensive, the menu could use a bit more expansion like include some add ons with its price, addition of more menu items (I dont know which but it is a suggestion) and I did notice the VIP lounge, wondering if they advertise that area for use The place can cater a group of 6 i think, especially in the rooftop portion with a nice view. One note though, The nacho menu doesnt put the cheese, condiments and the meat spread throughout from the top to bottom, leaving the bottom part to be bland without the cheese and other stuff, in my visit the large nachos were on top and as you get down, the piece are smaller until it goes to crumbs Overall the place was very nice, clean, and I advice bringing a jacket when staying upstairs, sometimes it would get drafty

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The view is amazing! A 360 degrees view of Davao City. They are open 24/7. You can choose the best time to capture the golden hours, sunrise or sunset. Expect a long line during special occasions. My favorite is beef tapa, german franks, and cheese burgers!

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Nice ambiance. 360 deck. Food was okay, beef is super chewy. We got 10% discount since it was my friend's birthday.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: If you're looking for a place to hangout with your friends, family, or date with someone, I highly recommend this place jud. Their food is so good and the place is so relaxing kase nasa roof top. U can visit anytime u want.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: First time eating on a dine in cafe/restaurant with no free water(staff(ambelle): no water serve for safety purposes. Does that mean food serve are not safe to eat?). Poor service and food taste same you can have on the street. But the place is good. 👍

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: 24 hours. Nice place to hang out and grab a bite at night (when it's not raining). Serves burger, chicken and nachos but nothing special. Friendly staff.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Located on one of the oldest streets in Dvo, I discovered this establishment through the Davao Food Guide page, which did not disappoint btw, lami ilang beef burgers plus pts ang stunning Davao-Samal view. Visit na po kayo.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The atmosphere is nice, relaxing. The staffs were also friendly and very accommodating. They even volunteer to take a picture with your barkada sa ilang cafe. But, they could use some improvement sa food. I'm not sure about the other food, since di pa namin na try, but our order (burger) was not good. The meat is dry, and walang lasa 🙁🙁. I hope in the future mag improve lasa ng burger nila.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: its a very realxing place during sundown cause the view is sounding like. amazing! the food is good and the staff is very approachable. 9/10 🥰

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Food was delicious, I ordered the crazy fries burger and the lychee cooler I really like them both I ordered the lychee cooler twice. It was self service but they did get me my drink the second time I ordered it and walking in and out was amazing as they were all in sync greeting me and my friends 10/10 would recommend

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: Line for Ordering takes too long to Move. No vacancy upstairs when we arrived so we ordered while waiting for a vacant table upstairs(which we're okay with). 2 groups behind us got tables first upstairs before us so we waited a bit longer than the other group. Food takes too long to be served. Edit: Food got served(Cold), but still waited for Vacancy Upstairs(Waited 30 minutes)

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: It is a great place especially when you see the view from above, food is tasty and staff is well accommodating.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The food was good but it would much be better if served hot. It's a good place to go on a date with your special someone and friends.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The Crazy Bite Co. is our favorite go to cafe. Me, personally, craves for their food always. They have a friendly environment and staff always greets us with a happy smile.

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe

place_name: The Crazy Bite Co. Sky Cafe
review_text: The location is pretty nice, if you're looking for a cozy place to eat while enjoying the city view. Food servings are generous. Service crews are nice and welcoming. It's a decent place to eat and chill, the music is not too loud. The restrooms are clean. They only have limited tables and chairs so you might have to wait a few minutes before you can secure a table, the staff is also accommodating, they will seat you right away if there are customers waiting to dine. So far, it has been a good experience. Their poppers are delicious because they are made out of chicken breast meat, their iced choco is delicious (not sure if they call it iced choco as long as it's in the non-coffee section) I like it because it's not too sweet and chocolatey, it's not like an instant choco drink. Their meal set B (2nd photo) is good for 2, you can order additional rice if you like rice ☺️. A few burgers are filling, the patty is big (I'm not a fan of the taste & texture) but maybe your taste buds will like it 😉
